description: Exploit Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) misconfigurations, specifically ESC1.  By requesting a certificate based on a overly permissive template that allows the enrollee to supply  a Subject Alternative Name (SAN), an attacker can impersonate highly privileged users (like Domain Admins) and seamlessly escalate privileges across the entire AD environment.
